title: Evidence-based pilot split and merge with lineage
goal: Evidence-based pilot split and merge with lineage
acceptance: Split proposed when sorties cluster in a subdomain with higher-scoring narrower set; merge proposed when two overlap; versioned lineage preserved and owner-approved
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Implemented evidence-based pilot split/merge proposals, versioned lineage, and owner-approved executors in 0.5 h agent.
